issue.title: Document hold admission and proc queue semantics
issue.description: Documentation follow-up explicitly requested by the approved sase-11l plan section 4.10 and phase sase-11l.10 note #1. Audited xprompts.md still has no hold row or proc queue guidance. The code feature remains in landing repair; perform this update after sase-11l completes. Scope is a bounded reference-note addition and one decision strand, so size medium. No duplicate in hold/queue memory searches, last-week task sweep, or the in-progress epic inventory.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Proposed by sase-11l.10 note #1. Add a %hold directive row and brief semantics to xprompts.md: scope, pending versus live selectors, mandatory bounded TTL, fail-open admission, family/proc terminal release, no running-work mutation, no %repeat/%dispatch composition. Document %queue on stand-alone procs, including default weight 0 and capacity behavior. Add a concise decisions web strand for the accepted pull model, fail-open TTL, and family-scoped release, with alternatives, costs, and reopening condition. Consult the completed hold implementation and plan:202609/hold_directive.md; do not claim unfinished landing repairs are complete. Publish authorized changes with sase memory init.

payload.entry: Reconcile audit (epic sase-1ae, phase reconcile): audited correction — ttl= is optional with a bounded default (default 2h, cap 12h), not mandatory; use _session_ terminology (agent-session rename sase-17m is closed) instead of the older _family_ wording. This bead already depends on sase-11l; adding the more precise sase-11l.11 dependency. Post-landing verification must check the landed hold contract before publishing. See consolidated audit (research:202609/memory_bead_backlog_audit/memory_bead_backlog_audit.md).
